notes.title: New updates of Neotrie VR, September 2020
notes.content:
After 6 months of work, we are excited to release a new version with substantial improvements and new functions, especially the 3d graphing calculator.  We remind you that we are open to all requests for improvement that you are sending us from all over the world. We are almost 1500 users on Steam! You can find many activities on our website http://www2.ual.es/neotrie
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33982122/74486e1a25bc9e2228c7f4a05fae7979a5e102b7.jpg[/img]

Here is what you will find now when you are in the welcome scene:
[list]
[*] One can choose either Hypatia or Euclides (active voice in German for Euclid, courtesy of Ronny Sitter,  Universität Chemnitz, Zentrum für Lehrerbildung).
[*] One can choose 3 different levels (beginner, normal, or expert) from less to more tools and options.
[*] We recommend to clear the data language and select again yours to download the last version on your computer.
[/list]

[h2]HAND ACTIONS IMPROVED:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Movable free points on lines and faces now available using the “plus” creator.
[*] Intersections of lines and planes available also using the “plus” creator.
[previewyoutube=1UDGLRzhzXM;full][/previewyoutube]

[*] Extrusion allowed for vertices, edges and faces, in particular to get prisms (has some bug for non cyclic faces) and also point extrusion to get pyramids, stars polyhedra, etc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33982122/ed75b7f6bdb3eec2fe1ebe1bda58fd431e315c67.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=Ow4YRn7Te6E;full][/previewyoutube]
[*] OBJ or STL models, and many other objects have restricted moves with the “edit” hand action, with respect to the 3d axis. Then, you can set the movement restrictions for example to x = 0.1, y = 0.1, z = 0.1 to move the objects 10 by 10 centimeters on each axis, ox = 1, y = 1, z = 0, if we want to move a object in the z direction. (Remember that the units of distance in Neotrie correspond to 1 = 1 meter.)
[previewyoutube=FOL0p9YAwto;full][/previewyoutube]
[/list]

[h2]3RD PERSON CAMERA AND 3D STEREOGRAPHIC PC SCREEN[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33982122/e8aa79cc9b2140ada98045e653643e971129203c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Option to see the game in stereografic double screen of the PC has been implemented in this version. This allows students to see a 3d video of Neotrie with their own VR phone glasses. It also permits to show pupils online lessons in real time.  
[*] Change this screen in the 3rd person camera, by pressing the little VR glasses icon. One can alternatively change this in the file.config (this must be downloaded in your local folder of Neotrie). Fix the desired value: 
[/list]
STEREOSCOPIC_SCREEN_RENDER = TRUE OR FALSE;

[h2]3D GRAPHING CALCULATOR (Beta version)[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33982122/cb07b906ec62102a421d82d8ac2386d21374c1d8.png[/img]
This version comes with a new 3d graphing calculator that we encourage you to try and send us improvement suggestions. This has been developed together with [url=http://www2.ual.es/neotrie/nueva-calculadora-grafica-3d/]Carmen Sánchez[/url]
[previewyoutube=GN7G6ZmT8_g;full][/previewyoutube]
Here is a list of what we can do with this new tool:
[list]
[*] Parametric curves and surfaces, internal (with editable parts) and external mode.
[*] One can change the parameters by using the bar sliders.
[*] Saving and loading a set of formulas of curves and surfaces.
[*] Formulas of a scene are saved in neot files, as lines starting with Formula.
[/list]

Here is an example of a line corresponding to a formula: 

Formula(;1;Cos(U)*Cos(V);Sin(U)*Cos(V);Sin(V);0;2π;12;-π/2; π/2; 6; 0; 1; 10; t; t; -1; 1; 10; 1; 1; 1; 1; CBFF96; FFAEC8; 000000)
These values are in order correspond to: 
[list]
[*] Scale
[*] X  
[*] Y
[*] Z
[*] Umin
[*] Umax
[*] SubdivisionsU
[*] Vmin
[*] Vmax
[*] SubdivisionsV
[*] Wmin (these will be used for 3d regions, and vector fields in future version)
[*] Wmax
[*] SubdivisionsW
[*] U(t) (first parameter for curve in surface)
[*] V(t) (second parameter for curve in surface)
[*] t-min
[*] t-max
[*] Subdivisions-t
[*] Alfa (parameter)
[*] Beta (parameter)
[*] Gamma (parameter)
[*] Delta (parameter)
[*] HEX color of surface
[*] HEX color of curve in surface
[*] HEX color of meridians and parallels
[/list]

A video with more examples and explenations will be published soon.

[h2]OTHERS IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added option in file.config and 3D calculator: ALLOW_PASTE to enable or disable gluing figures by their vertices.
[*] Added some warning and player helping messages.
[*] Clones of music spheres are saved now with its own scale.
[*] Loci pencil paints edges too.
[/list]

[h2]KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS:[/h2]
[list]
[*] E hides/shows edges
[*] T	hides/shows first tutorial
[*] C	loads file.config
[*] F+3	 loads file3.neot (or its assigned file in file.config). 
[*] H	 hides/shows figures (for the scanner screen).
[/list]
Other keyboard shortcuts can be added, under request of users. We

notes.title: New updates of Neotrie VR, January 2020
notes.content:
We are very pleased to announce some new features in Neotrie VR, specially interesting for teachers (and users in general) who want to create a VR scene including a variety of elements (3D objects, images, 360 backgrounds, sounds, texts, etc.). The main point is that you can do all of this scene easily,  directly inside the VR scene.

[h1] New panels with activities[/h1]
Some activities have been included in the VR scenario. Users are welcome to submit their work to be included in the game. We invite you  to join us in our global and collaborative [url=https://sites.google.com/ual.es/neotrie-forum/]community[/url].
[previewyoutube=-Uwej6d6Vqg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New “nets generator” and "scanner" tools[/h1] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33982122/883a2b1ec557ed7a604433e8930be57570ad83c0.png[/img]
(Inside a diamond structure; picture published in [url=http://boletinmatematico.ual.es/Boletin_de_la_Titulacion_de_Matematicas_de_la_UAL/Bienvenida_files/Vol13_1.pdf]this article[/url].)

Use the net generator tool to build crystal structures from unit cells, with parameters a, b, c, alpha, beta, gamma. One can also fix these paramenters in the updated file.config (download an example [url=https://drive.google.com/a/ual.es/file/d/1RxPyoznUTclsom5B_2BetIvRUkjp8jo4/view?usp=sharing]here[/url], and put it in your folder Documents\\Neotrie\\Config. To load it, press the key "C" of your keyboard when playing in the temple).

[previewyoutube=DXPfUA7JyzE;full][/previewyoutube]

On the other hand, the scanner screen permits  users to see projections of crystals or any other figure, as well as their sections ("cut figure" button). The "Hiden figure"  button (or the key "H" on the keyboard) allows to hide all figures in the scene. This can be used to create exercises asking pupils to discover figures from their projections or sections. 
We are preparing some scenes with crystals and its projections, that we will publish shortly, made in collaboration with the Palais de la Découverte, of Paris. 

[h1]New “divisor” tool[/h1] Use this tool to have rational points m/n on a segment (can be changed in [url=https://drive.google.com/a/ual.es/file/d/1RxPyoznUTclsom5B_2BetIvRUkjp8jo4/view?usp=sharing]file.config[/url]). 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33982122/ed1bd5e27d33db0556b0c9fefc8ae71b35f38a19.png[/img]

[h1]New “physics” tool[/h1] 
Use this tool to add or delete gravity to objects (STL/OBJ type). (This object property will be saved on a neot file in the next version.)
[previewyoutube=DliZrF1PdaQ;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]Slider tool improved[/h1] 
We have a new option to generate circles, and a button “restart” to restart the moves.
[previewyoutube=7_9dVtZZMD4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Intersection tool improved[/h1] 
Intersection tool has been improved. Now it cuts a plane with a line, or two planes just touching the planes. Recall that one can add coordinates, names, equations, etc. with the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/878620/partnerevents/view/2665493825327087916]label tool[/url].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33982122/ed0e7eb816c739b2acc91a2e608a6f259396456a.png[/img]

[h1] Bisector tool improved[/h1]
Bisector works now by touching two adjacent edges.
 
[h1]Save and load scenes improved[/h1]
One can now save clones of musical notes, 360 balls with panorama pictures, and  tools! This allows to save songs, prepare and save a visit to some 360 pictures, etc. 

[h1]Further improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Basic mode “edit” moves also faces.
[*] Basic mode “create” makes faces too, after  touching 3 or more vertices, maintaining the trigger button pressed.
[*] Perpendicular tool allows to make projections of a vertex on a line or plane.
[*] Others.
[/list]

[h1]Fixed bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*] Some tools did not work when touching double points. Now this bug is fixed, by automatically choosing vertex of the double point.
[*] The white line on the left hand has been disabled, when restriction moves are activated.
[*] Sometimes 360 balls did not permit to come back to the temple. Now, this is fixed.
[*] Slider tool failed if one of the selected points was deleted or taken with the hand. Now, it skips to the next vertice on the list.
[/list]

[h1]Important non fixed bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*] Gluing figures along vertices produce some bugs, when deleting vertices/edges later on.
[*] Drawings and physics property of objects cannot be saved yet in the scene.
[*] Sometimes, video and sound are not coupled in the recorded video. 
[/list]
Please, let us know if you encounter other unsolved bugs in this updated version.

We are happy about all the sugestions received by many of you. Thank you all for walking with us on this great adventure and enjoy maths in VR as we do.

notes.title: Labeling in Neotrie VR
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33982122/68b78d47942e0f5f2342bec7d76348abdb0dbd16.png[/img]

These new tools will be very useful to make 3d geometry more interesting for educational purposes. If you have any doubt please contact us!

[h1]Info labels of geometric elements[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33982122/2c544359ef1b1847b66128a7b7a869e0039d6453.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33982122/0b6adf6b6f674cb28a243410a8c8a42c58c1ebf5.png[/img]

Here you have a video of how these tools work.
[previewyoutube=tKaiZRBx5lE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Button true and false for test activities[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33982122/c4bc94102a2f064b18465694492dd5fcdcd2dd15.png[/img]
In the next video, we shwow how to use the new label tool to make tests in VR, with scores. 
We use <button correct=t> and <button correct=f> for true or false.
<nhits> for number of hits,  <nerrors>  number of errors.
[previewyoutube=IyJOq9Zg2Xo;full][/previewyoutube]

In the example file  [url=https://drive.google.com/a/ual.es/file/d/1Y6mql8oFW2Zg2rEpedVe_LBx3ulJXNnU/view?usp=sharing]test1.neot[/url] one can change texts, possitions, and values of buttons  ((t=true,  f=false).


[h1]Buttons to link to other scenes[/h1]
We can use objects as "doors" to other scenes. Use the label tool, touch on the air or on any object (jpg, STL, OBJ), and then insert <button loadfile=test1> to link tto the file test1.neot. 
[previewyoutube=Tk0DYpyyWzM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Next updates of Neotrie VR, July 2019
notes.content:
[i][Updated August 3, 2019:] We are still fixing some bugs on the Neotrie's version of July, 2009, and testing with our collaborators. We will be back with news in September 2019. In the meanwhile, follow us in social networks #neotrie  #neotrievr[/i]

Here are the new tools, improvements, and new features that will be implemented in the forthcoming version of Neotrie VR. We have also included some tricks and instructions for teachers to prepare activities and lessons plans to be opened quickly in the classroom.

We warn that the multiplayer mode will not be active temporarily, due to recent updates in the Unity platform, but we could not wait to offer the advantages that this new version brings.

Recall that you can see the current user guide at:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1587953976

[h1]New loading menu[/h1]
Figures, pictures, objects, sounds, etc. can be loaded directly in the scene with a new windows menu (available formats .neot, .stl, .obj, .jpg, waw, .config, see more details below). 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33982122/90c16aab90af5255f099cc7ae5d0e7317302a03f.jpg[/img]


[h1]New importing Obj files[/h1]
OBJ and STL are the most extended formats for 3D objects. Almost all known softwares have this format implemented. In this version, you will be able to import OBJ/STL files from the load and save menu, as well as from the new windows menu. Once in the scene, we can take them with your hands paint and rescale all its parts and save them in your Neot file, for improving your lessons and activities.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33982122/094534d1aac817ca3cea320517b7247b998ddf2c.jpg[/img]

[h1]New importing pictures[/h1]
One can insert pictures (JPG format) on the scene from the new windows menu. These pictures can be taken, and enlarged as other objects.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33982122/1fbd4b470c42011089299c79edb7df73f7c12f82.jpg[/img]

[h1]New changing 360º backgrounds[/h1]
Are you ready to have your geometric constructions in any place of the world? One can change the background of the scene with any desired 360 picture (JPG format). Open it from your folder “environments 360” and move it inside the ball of 360º picture. Now take the ball and approach it to your head.  See this video: https://youtu.be/YFDVUSCISQc
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33982122/983e64dc5ab0f26071b9f6b5b94f9ef11fa12b35.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33982122/23e394763d94228135e129494c6e6a5aafb49434.jpg[/img]

One can use the copy tool to have several 360 balls, with distinct environments.
[previewyoutube=_F_yjXV8M34;full][/previewyoutube]

Can use [url=https://svd360.istreetview.com/]Street View download 360[/url] to download pictures from Google Earth, for instance.

[h1]Music[/h1]
Combine geometry and music, by touching the music balls with your hands (or free drawing, objects, balls of the shuttle, etc.). Make any object sound with any chosen waw file. Use the authomatic sliders to move vertices, edges or faces that can touch musical objects to get melodies and rhythms.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33982122/dbf3f2f00f419c9fce76a8808b8f3d9600277472.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=fcu_LocnCio;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New multiview projections[/h1]
Multiview planes are now available with applications to engineering drawing.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33982122/5e31b07b1b6cc7ca6e9f5e8e0e160e85c2222557.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33982122/2fff50ba56a77f0855cfef2c061aa26e449f9f92.jpg[/img]

[h1]New bisector tool[/h1]
Touch three vertices A, B, C to get a point P that bisects the edges AB and AC. This can be useful for instance to find the incenter and the incircle of a triangle. In the next version, it will work touching two edges.
[previewyoutube=nFKxBPLPFKc;full]https://youtu.be/nFKxBPLPFKc[/previewyoutube]

[h1]New selector tool[/h1]
This new tool can hide a list of vertices and edges (touch menu button when taking the tool).
[previewyoutube=KW8o0Wciet8;full]https://youtu.be/KW8o0Wciet8 [/previewyoutube]

It can be also used to rotate a selection of vertices, for instance to make a cube from a net.
[previewyoutube=o4ijwG-nP8E;full][/previewyoutube]
of of a dodecahedron
[previewyoutube=1vv2tPNZJA8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New loci pencil[/h1]
This is the black pencil on the table. This draws the trace of a vertex when it moves. Ready to make plenty of curves?
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33982122/31d69eb9d2fb2823db99e3369addea4054d5802d.jpg[/img]

[h1]New slider tool[/h1]
This new tool allows to automatically move a point passing through a set of vertices.
[previewyoutube=rp87XTLOizE;full][/previewyoutube]

This can be used to make plenty of known curves, like for example the conics. We will incluse soon a video here.



[h1]New boxes[/h1]
New boxes are now available with top lids, both are editable, scalable, coloreable. Ask your pupils classify polhyedra or set of figures by types, transport them on the scene.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33982122/a8fd78a2aa0c65050054d78f3ccf526c75c2606d.jpg[/img]

[h1]New shuttle[/h1]
Shuttles are entering the game with interesting didactical applications. Both the shuttles and the balls are scalable and paintable. They interact with objects. The larger the gun, the larger the balls.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33982122/abb160f566ecdf893ffbd2878b82c04213c8b8ca.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33982122/42186d5acc6a1977b2ead387921fd914bfd68ff0.jpg[/img]


[h1]New video-camera[/h1]
Video-camera has been implemented with a button to start and stop recording inside the scene. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33982122/c8c39da156ef2ac6f306bd909e115c9350da88ad.jpg[/img]

Videos are saved in the local folder 
Documents>Neotrie>Videos


[h1]Protractor tool improved[/h1]
The protractor tool gives the dihedral angle between two faces. While maintained the trigger button pressed, touch over one plane and then over another.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33982122/d0f2d4a8f0e1c9a7c9726e8c7bdf50273e5b01dd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Magnet tool improved[/h1]
This tool allows users to join tiles by two of their edges. It also joins two 3D figures by two of their faces, or also two pair of edges, as shows the video:


[h1]Copy tool improved[/h1]
The copy tool can now copy STL, OBJ objects, free drawings and pictures, and also the tools you see over the table! Use the copy tool to copy the 5 platonic solids of our logo, enlarge, and colour them.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33982122/a489446fc050278a8e1b3298d6ea1fdfdd010c44.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=TIZEEhI_fdw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Load your set of tools everywhere you like[/h1]
Open the hand manu, and pass your hand over picture with a little compass, to hide all the tools. Touch it again to open the tools at your current place in the scene.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33982122/1479796f464edfdb3de231cc8c29d24acebff861.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33982122/8066020e2fc5a50cf3f9c98ac9021d0bbd9c21a0.jpg[/img]


[h1]Saving system improved[/h1]
Neot files keep information of all the elements available in a scene of Neotrie VR: vertices, edges, faces (and their colors), STL, OBJ, JPG, waw, etc. 
It also keeps the last position of the player when saving the file.

You can edit this files with any text edit, and update old files to this new version as follows. Now, these have the property of being universal, valid for all users. For example, the following lines shows how a figure of type STL is saved in the neot file: position, rotation, scaling, route of the file, and colour of the figure.

Figure(;Objeto;(1.9007, -56.1768, 4.1312);(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);(1.0000, 1.0000, 1.0000);[documents]\\Neotrie\\Objects\\Plane.stl;RGBA(0.000, 0.000, 1.000, 1.000);0;)

Therefore, you must change the route of any STL file from an old neot file, for example, 
C:\\users\\documents\\Neotrie\\Objects\\Plane.stl
by
[documents]\\Neotrie\\Objects\\Plane.stl

[h1]New autosave option[/h1]
In the windows menu, look at the folder 000_Autosaves to access to automatic copies of your scene, every 5 minutes. 

[h1]Faster loading from keyboard
[/h1]This option is useful for lessons, to repeat the same activity with different students. To facilitate this, a faster loading of .neot files has been implemented by using the keys F+0, F+1, …., F+9, L to load file0.neot, file1.neot, file2.neot,... respectively from your NeotrieSaves folder.  These names of files can be changed in a config file, as shown below.


[h1]New config files[/h1]
Choose the tools that you want to see on the scene, indicating TRUE or FALSE in the [url=http://www2.ual.es/neotrie/Config/file.config]file.config[/url]. You must have this file in the folder
 Documents>Neotrie>Config

This can be edited as a text file. Take care to save it as  file.config (and not as file.config.txt). This file can be loaded from the new loading menu. You can have as many config files as you like, naming differently, and maintaining the extension .config. , Pressing the key C to load the default file.config.

One can automatically upload a config file executing a neot scene, including the following line in the neot file:

ConfigFileRoute = [documents]\\Neotrie\\Config\\file.config

You can have different config files for every activity o set of activities. 
For instance one can rename the files to load automatically with the keyboard by fixing the route of the name in the config file:
FILE0= namefile0
FILE1= namefile1
FILE2= namefile2
...
FILE9= namefile9

[h1]Further changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Size of vertices can be changed in the main menu, as well as relative local scale.
[*] Edges size can be change in the main menu, and they can also be drawn by touching a vertice and maintaining pressed until the second vertice.
[*] Faces can be drawn by the mode “triangle” and touching the vertices, maintaining pressed.
[/list]



Credits: 
[list]
[*] Edited and produced by José L. Rodríguez (University of Almería)
[*] Software developed by Diego Cangas (Virtual Dor)
[/list]
Any reproduction of text, images and videos without prior permission of the authors is prohibited.
